parts.description: Owns the indicator host and its Angular children until its exit motion finishes.

inputs.name: rdxRadioIndicatorPresence
inputs.description: Use `{ keepMounted: true }` to retain the unchecked view.

inputs.name: keepMounted
inputs.description: Leave an attribute-only host displayed when unchecked. Structural ownership has its own option.

parts.description:
The hidden native radio input that mirrors the item state for form submission, native validation,
and `<label>` activation. Place it inside an `rdxRadioItem`.

See https://base-ui.com/react/components/radio

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: ID for an explicit native label. Defaults to the item ID with an `-input` suffix.

inputs.name: aria-describedby
inputs.description: Additional description IDs. Group and item Field descriptions are appended automatically.

inputs.name: aria-labelledby
inputs.description: Override the accessible label supplied by Field.Item.

inputs.name: inputRef
inputs.description: Called with the item's authored input after rendering and released when it detaches.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description:
Whether the user should be unable to select this radio button. Bound in templates as
`readOnly` (Base UI spelling); the TS member stays `readonly` for cross-primitive consistency.

inputs.name: aria-describedby
inputs.description: Additional description IDs. Field descriptions and errors are appended automatically.

inputs.name: aria-labelledby
inputs.description: Override the accessible label supplied by Field or Fieldset.

inputs.name: controlledValue
inputs.description: Parent-owned selection. A defined value, including null, takes precedence over the editable model.

inputs.name: defaultValue
inputs.description: Initial selection when neither a value binding nor an Angular form supplies one.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: ID of the radiogroup, used for the enclosing Field's focus target.

inputs.name: inputRef
inputs.description: Called with the group's representative authored input and released when the binding changes.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description:
Whether the user should be unable to select a different radio button. Bound in templates as
`readOnly` (Base UI spelling); the TS member stays `readonly` for cross-primitive consistency.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description:
The editable form value. Use a unique value per option and null for no selection.
Object and array values are compared by reference.
Accepts local edits and connects to Angular Forms or `[(value)]`.

inputs.name: dirty
inputs.description: Whether the value changed from its initial value. Merged with internal tracking.

inputs.name: errors
inputs.description: Validation errors for the control. A non-empty list marks it invalid.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Whether the control is invalid. A non-empty {@link errors} list also marks it invalid.

inputs.name: pending
inputs.description: Whether async validation is pending. Pending controls publish neither `data-valid` nor `data-invalid`.

inputs.name: touched
inputs.description: Whether the control has been touched. A `model()` so Signal Forms can write it; set on blur/focus-out.

outputs.name: onValueChange
outputs.description: Event handler called when the value changes.

outputs.name: touch
outputs.description: Emits when the control is touched, notifying Signal Forms (stable Angular 22 contract).
